svg.text: The spinal cord ends as the conus medullaris at about the
L1–L2 vertebral level in adults.
成人脊髓在约第 1–2 腰椎水平止于脊髓圆锥。
Below it, the lumbar and sacral roots run down the dural
sac as the cauda equina.
其下方的腰、骶神经根在硬脊膜囊内下行，组成马尾。
Each lumbar root leaves below the vertebra of the same
number, hooking around the pedicle above its own-level
disc: the L4 root exits at L4–L5.
每条腰神经根在同序数椎骨下方穿出，绕过本节段椎间盘上方的椎弓根
：L4 神经根从 L4–L5 椎间孔出。
The dorsal root ganglion lies in or close to the
intervertebral foramen; lower lumbar ganglia are more
often inside it.
背根神经节位于椎间孔内或其附近；下腰椎的神经节更常位于孔内。
Outside the foramen the spinal nerve splits into a dorsal
ramus (back) and a ventral ramus (front).
出孔后脊神经分为后支（向后）和前支（向前）。
Ventral rami L1–L4 form the lumbar plexus in psoas major
(femoral nerve L2–L4); L4–S3 join the sciatic nerve.
前支 L1–L4 在腰大肌内组成腰丛（股神经 L2–L4）；
L4–S3 汇成坐骨神经。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
